stalls.where: 羅斯福路四段108巷2號；週一休（部分資料寫週日亦休）
stalls.summaryZh: 米其林必比登常客，外酥內有嚼勁，九層塔配蜂蜜芥末是特色；排隊常態，現做時最不油。
stalls.summaryEn: Bib Gourmand regular: crisp outside, chewy inside, with a signature basil and honey-mustard combo. Usually a queue; best eaten fresh.

sources.title: 食尚玩家｜2026公館美食15家推薦
udn橘世代｜公館夜市人氣美食TOP7（2025）

stalls.where: 羅斯福路三段316巷8弄3號（近捷運公館2、4號出口）；週一休
stalls.summaryZh: 可指定肥瘦比例的割包名店，配花生粉、酸菜、香菜很對味，瘦肉也不柴；假日排隊長。
stalls.summaryEn: Famous gua bao where you choose the fat-to-lean ratio; peanut powder, pickles and cilantro round it out, and even lean pork stays moist. Long weekend lines.

sources.title: 食尚玩家｜2026公館美食15家推薦

stalls.where: 羅斯福路四段108巷8-1號；週三休
stalls.summaryZh: 全素、現炸，外脆內Q有地瓜香，不少人說是吃過最好吃的地瓜球；尖峰排隊、一鍋常很快賣完，放涼口感會變。
stalls.summaryEn: Vegan and fried fresh: crisp shell, chewy center, real sweet-potato flavor. Many call it the best they've had; lines at peak times, and it's best hot.

stalls.zh: 劉記古早味蔥蛋餅蜜地瓜
stalls.where: 羅斯福路四段108巷2-3號；週三、四休
stalls.summaryZh: 麵糊型古早味蛋餅，厚軟、蔥給很多，自製辣椒醬受嗜辣者推薦；不下雨時常大排長龍。
stalls.summaryEn: Old-style batter pancake, thick and soft with lots of scallion; the house chili sauce wins over spice fans. Long lines on dry nights.

sources.title: 兔兒毛毛姊妹花｜2026公館夜市TOP10
udn橘世代｜公館夜市人氣美食TOP7（2025）

stalls.where: 羅斯福路四段108巷10號；週一休
stalls.summaryZh: 外皮酥脆、肉多汁，可選越式酸辣等醬料，內用生菜無限供應；晚上人潮多，網友說老闆很大方。
stalls.summaryEn: Crisp, juicy boneless cutlet with Vietnamese-style sauces and unlimited lettuce for dine-in. Busy at night; the owner is known as generous.

stalls.zh: 速肚與雞情（素食鹹酥雞）
stalls.summaryZh: 少見的素食鹹酥雞攤，炸物口味爽口不油，葷食者也吃得開心。
stalls.summaryEn: A rare vegetarian fried-snack stall; light, non-greasy flavors that meat-eaters enjoy too.

sources.title: 兔兒毛毛姊妹花｜2026公館夜市TOP10

stalls.where: 羅斯福路四段24巷內（近捷運公館4號出口）；週三休
stalls.summaryZh: 約45年老攤，品質穩定，豬血糕軟Q、醬汁甜鹹，可選辣度。
stalls.summaryEn: A roughly 45-year-old stall with consistent quality: soft, chewy blood cake in a sweet-savory sauce, spice level to taste.

sources.title: 食尚玩家｜2026公館美食15家推薦

stalls.summaryZh: 底部酥脆、餡飽滿多汁，是許多台大學生懷念的平價小吃，常被建議搭冰豆漿。
stalls.summaryEn: Crisp-bottomed, juicy buns that many NTU alumni remember fondly; often paired with iced soy milk.
